title: Apple confirms it's affected by the big Google-discovered processor flaws, but it's already issuing fixes (AAPL)
text: Apple confirms it's affected by the big Google-discovered processor flaws, but it's already issuing fixes (AAPL) By Matt Weinberger Jan 4, 2018, 7:22 pm For the first time, Apple has publicly commented on "Meltdown" and "Spectre" — the Google-discovered security flaws that affect almost everything with a processor, and that can reveal sensitive information like passwords or photos. And yes, Apple says in its blog entry, the Mac, iPhone, iPad, and…
